visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with reddish-brown hair tied back with a leopard print bow wears a black halter neck tank top. She stands in a room with white paneled walls next to a brown upright piano, gesturing energetically with her hands and arms while looking directly at the camera. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a digital tablet resting on the piano’s music stand, displaying complex sheet music. A hand enters the frame, scrolling through the dense notation. The woman’s face is visible briefly, looking overwhelmed and pointing at the screen. (3) The woman sits on the piano bench, leaning into the keys. She begins playing a rapid sequence of notes with both hands, her eyes wide and focused. Visual text overlays like '密密麻麻' and '花容失色' flash on the screen to emphasize the difficulty. (4) She stops playing abruptly, throwing her head back and clutching her forehead with both hands. Her mouth is open in a wide shout or laugh. She leans forward, resting her head on the piano keys in a gesture of humorous defeat. (5) The scene shifts to a stylized animation of a mountain range under a bright sky. Large Traditional Chinese characters '收斂一下心情' are centered over the landscape as butterflies flutter in the foreground.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short-form vlog where a pianist attempts to play a notoriously difficult arrangement of the song 'Idol' by YOASOBI. The purpose is to entertain viewers by showcasing the technical complexity of the piece contrasted with the creator's exaggerated emotional reaction and comedic failure, building a relatable narrative of professional struggle.
